capabilities: compile free-form notes into a structured knowledge base (entities, concepts, comparisons, queries)
query the knowledge base with deterministic, cited answers
serve knowledge bases to agents over MCP and a CLI
report stale notes and knowledge-base health
extras: Desktop-only (needs local CLI tools and Electron APIs). Claims no telemetry and is free; the optional Jev cook triage sends note paths, titles, frontmatter, and the first 15 non-empty lines to api.typesafe.ai when an API key is configured. Full documentation lives outside the README.
intentEvidence: BYOAO is archived — its role is fully superseded.
motivation: The author had built BYOAO, a predecessor that turned Obsidian into an LLM-Wiki-style knowledge base, and wanted the same ideas as a first-class Obsidian plugin.
problem: Obsidian vaults hold free-form notes that AI agents can only re-read from scratch, with no persistent structure, measured retrieval, or cited answers.
